# Uzbekcha TTS — Complete AI Integration Guide

> Free Uzbek Text-to-Speech — Natural Uzbek AI Voice Generator
> Website: https://tts-uzbek.onrender.com
> GitHub: https://github.com/developer-uzbek/tts-uzbek

## Service Overview

Uzbekcha TTS converts text to natural speech using Microsoft Edge Neural TTS voices.
Primary language: Uzbek. Also supports Russian, English, Turkish, and Kazakh.
Output format: MP3 audio (audio/mpeg).
No API key required. Free to use.

## How to Generate Uzbek Audio

### Method 1: Simple GET request (easiest)

```
GET https://tts-uzbek.onrender.com/tts.mp3?q=Salom%2C%20dunyo!
```

Returns: MP3 binary audio (Content-Type: audio/mpeg)

### Method 2: POST with JSON body (recommended for AI agents)

```
POST https://tts-uzbek.onrender.com/api/tts
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "text": "Salom, dunyo!",
  "voice": "uz-UZ-SardorNeural"
}
```

Returns: MP3 binary audio (Content-Type: audio/mpeg)

### Method 3: GET with query parameters

```
GET https://tts-uzbek.onrender.com/api/tts?text=Salom&voice=uz-UZ-SardorNeural
```

Returns: MP3 binary audio (Content-Type: audio/mpeg)

## Available Uzbek Voices

| Voice ID | Name | Gender | Language |
|---|---|---|---|
| uz-UZ-SardorNeural | Sardor | male | Uzbek |
| uz-UZ-MadinaNeural | Madina | female | Uzbek |

Additional voices available:
| Voice ID | Name | Gender | Language |
|---|---|---|---|
| ru-RU-DmitryNeural | Dmitry | male | Russian |
| ru-RU-SvetlanaNeural | Svetlana | female | Russian |
| en-US-AndrewNeural | Andrew | male | English |
| en-US-AriaNeural | Aria | female | English |
| tr-TR-AhmetNeural | Ahmet | male | Turkish |
| tr-TR-EmelNeural | Emel | female | Turkish |
| kk-KZ-DauletNeural | Daulet | male | Kazakh |
| kk-KZ-AigulNeural | Aigul | female | Kazakh |

Get full voice list: GET https://tts-uzbek.onrender.com/api/voices

## Voice Selection Shortcuts

Instead of using the full voice ID, you can use shortcuts:

- By name: `"voice": "sardor"` or `"voice": "madina"`
- By language: `"voice": "uz"` (defaults to male)
- By language+gender: `"voice": "uz-female"` (selects Madina)
- Separate params: `"lang": "uz", "gender": "female"`

## Request Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| text (or q, r) | string | Yes | Text to convert to speech (max 5000 characters) |
| voice (or v) | string | No | Voice ID, name, or shortcut. Default: uz-UZ-SardorNeural |
| lang | string | No | Language code: uz, ru, en, tr, kk |
| gender | string | No | male or female |
| style | string | No | natural, deep, chipmunk, hype, calm. Default: natural |
| rate | integer | No | Speed adjustment, -50 to 100. Default: 0 |
| pitch | integer | No | Pitch adjustment, -50 to 50. Default: 0 |
| volume | integer | No | Volume adjustment. Default: 0 |
| dl | string | No | Set to "1" to force download (Content-Disposition: attachment) |
| name | string | No | Custom filename (without .mp3 extension) |

## Voice Styles

| Style | Description | Speed | Pitch | Volume |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| natural | Natural, default | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| deep | Deep and heavy | -20% | -40 Hz | +10% |
| chipmunk | High-pitched and fast | +25% | +55 Hz | 0 |
| hype | Energetic, fast, loud | +45% | +8 Hz | +20% |
| calm | Slow and soft | -35% | -8 Hz | -35% |

## Complete Python Example

```python
import requests

# Generate Uzbek speech
response = requests.post(
    "https://tts-uzbek.onrender.com/api/tts",
    json={
        "text": "Assalomu alaykum! Uzbekcha TTS xizmatiga xush kelibsiz.",
        "voice": "uz-UZ-SardorNeural",
        "style": "natural",
        "rate": 0,
        "pitch": 0
    }
)

# Verify the response is valid audio
if response.status_code == 200 and response.headers.get("Content-Type") == "audio/mpeg":
    # Save the MP3 file
    filename = "uzbekcha-tts-output.mp3"
    with open(filename, "wb") as f:
        f.write(response.content)
    print(f"Audio saved: {filename} ({len(response.content)} bytes)")
else:
    print(f"Error: HTTP {response.status_code}")
    if response.headers.get("Content-Type", "").startswith("application/json"):
        print(response.json().get("message", "Unknown error"))
```

## Complete JavaScript Example (Node.js)

```javascript
const fs = require('fs');
const https = require('https');

const data = JSON.stringify({
    text: "Assalomu alaykum! Uzbekcha TTS xizmatiga xush kelibsiz.",
    voice: "uz-UZ-SardorNeural"
});

const options = {
    hostname: 'tts-uzbek.onrender.com',
    path: '/api/tts',
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(data)
    }
};

const req = https.request(options, (res) => {
    if (res.statusCode === 200) {
        const chunks = [];
        res.on('data', chunk => chunks.push(chunk));
        res.on('end', () => {
            const buffer = Buffer.concat(chunks);
            fs.writeFileSync('uzbekcha-tts-output.mp3', buffer);
            console.log(`Audio saved: ${buffer.length} bytes`);
        });
    } else {
        console.error(`Error: HTTP ${res.statusCode}`);
    }
});

req.write(data);
req.end();
```

## cURL Examples

```bash
# Simple GET — generate and save Uzbek audio
curl "https://tts-uzbek.onrender.com/tts.mp3?q=Salom%2C%20dunyo!" -o uzbekcha-tts-output.mp3

# POST with JSON — recommended method
curl -X POST https://tts-uzbek.onrender.com/api/tts \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"text":"Salom, dunyo!","voice":"uz-UZ-SardorNeural"}' \
  -o uzbekcha-tts-output.mp3

# Female voice
curl -X POST https://tts-uzbek.onrender.com/api/tts \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"text":"Salom, dunyo!","voice":"uz-UZ-MadinaNeural"}' \
  -o uzbekcha-tts-output.mp3

# With style
curl -X POST https://tts-uzbek.onrender.com/api/tts \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"text":"Salom!","voice":"sardor","style":"deep","rate":10}' \
  -o uzbekcha-tts-output.mp3

# List voices
curl https://tts-uzbek.onrender.com/api/voices | python -m json.tool
```

## Error Handling

| HTTP Status | Meaning | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Success | Response body is MP3 audio |
| 400 | Bad request | Check text and parameters |
| 413 | Text too long | Split text into chunks of max 5000 characters |
| 429 | Rate limited | Wait 10 seconds and retry |
| 502 | TTS engine error | Retry after a few seconds |

Error response format (JSON):
```json
{
  "status": "error",
  "message": "Description of the error"
}
```

## Rate Limits

- 40 new text requests per minute per IP address
- Cached requests (same text + voice) do not count toward the limit
- When rate limited, the response includes a Retry-After header

## How to Verify Audio is Valid

1. Check HTTP status is 200
2. Check Content-Type header is "audio/mpeg"
3. Check response body is not empty
4. Check response body starts with bytes that indicate MP3 format (ID3 header or FF FB/FF F3 sync bytes)

## Important Notes for AI Assistants

1. The API returns BINARY AUDIO DATA, not a URL or text.
2. To deliver audio to a user, you must:
   a. Make the HTTP request to generate the audio
   b. Save the binary response to a file
   c. Attach the file to your response (if your platform supports file attachments)
   d. OR provide a direct download URL: https://tts-uzbek.onrender.com/tts.mp3?q=URL_ENCODED_TEXT
3. A URL alone is NOT an audio file. You must actually download the audio binary.
4. If your platform does not support file attachments, provide the download URL and explain that the user needs to open it.
5. Do not fabricate or hallucinate file attachments. Only attach files you have actually downloaded and saved.
6. The Render free tier may have cold start delays (up to 30 seconds). If the first request times out, try again.
